# KiDS-1000 Brouwer et al. (2021) selected data

This directory contains only the six source files required by DarkPipe 0.12: the upstream README, four stellar-mass-bin ESD radial profiles, and their joint covariance matrix. The selected bytes total 644,285 bytes; the full 2.3 MB release and survey images/catalogues are not mirrored.

Source: [KiDS science data release for Brouwer et al. (2021)](https://kids.strw.leidenuniv.nl/sciencedata.php), distributed by the KiDS collaboration under [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). The KiDS policy states that its public and high-level scientific data products may be reused with proper acknowledgement.

Required scientific citation:

> Brouwer, M. M. et al. (2021), “The weak lensing radial acceleration relation: Constraining modified gravity and cold dark matter theories with KiDS-1000”, *Astronomy & Astrophysics* 650, A113. DOI: [10.1051/0004-6361/202040108](https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202040108).

DarkPipe code remains GPL-3.0-or-later. These data retain their upstream CC BY 4.0 boundary; GPL does not relicense them.

## Frozen source receipt

The upstream tarball was retrieved from `https://kids.strw.leidenuniv.nl/sci_data/brouwer2021_rar.tar` with SHA-256 `73adc2d4e848fa0a6a43187f7b5447e749b92eaec4a795b9902b0beaf8a78733` and size 2,430,464 bytes. Only the named non-Apple-metadata files were selected. Per-file hashes are frozen in the v0.12 preregistration and tests.
